From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@amplihealth.com>, Megan Zhao <megan.zhao@amplihealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AmpliHealth activation: Sales→CS handoff & next steps

Hi team —

Good news: AmpliHealth signed yesterday afternoon and returned the countersigned SOW. High level context to help CS take the lead:

- Product: intent detection + triage embeddings for patient intake forms (initial scope = 5 intake forms, English only).
- Target go-live: pilot with internal staff July 2027? (customer suggested 2026-10-15 to start pilot sandbox; see timeline attached).
- Billing/contract: 12-month term, monthly invoicing, committed throughput 200k tokens/month with burst to 500k.

Attachments: AmpliHealth_SOW_v1.pdf, Activation_Timeline_v1.xlsx (timeline is provisional per their ask).

Key asks for CS:
1) Validate the pilot acceptance criteria and update the timeline (Samir and Megan asked for a 6-week sprint to pilot).
2) Confirm owners for technical onboarding (API keys, VPC peering is on their roadmap but may be optional).
3) Identify any preflight security artifacts they will need (Samir asked about SOC2 in the next 48h).

Internal notes / risks:
- They plan to send a security questionnaire by EOD 8/11; procurement expects turnaround within 5 business days.
- We may need to propose Redwood Dedicated if they require guaranteed throughput; sales will support that discussion.
- No PII expected in pilot but they will supply real, de-identified intake forms.

Ben / Laura / Tessa — can you pick primary and backup stewards and confirm a kickoff window next week? Samir / Megan — if the suggested kickoff window (8/18–8/20) works for you, we’ll lock calendar invites.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- I’ll review the SOW and Timeline after this note and confirm whether Dedicated is recommended for the pilot or only for production.

Hi Samir / Megan —

Great — thanks for confirming the kickoff. Minimal SOC2 onboarding evidence we typically ask for to move the security intake forward:

- SOC2 Type II report PDF (latest 12-month period)
- Contact for security owner + security questionnaire response (we will send our standard intake form)
- Network diagram showing data flow (even at a high level)
- Any data residency or retention constraints spelled out

If you can share the SOC2 PDF and the security owner contact by 8/14 we can review and let you know if we need anything else before kickoff.

Tentative owners and responsibilities (confirming Ben’s note):
- Ben Carter (primary technical steward) — API, throughput validation, test harness support
- Laura Bennett (delivery/acceptance) — pilot acceptance criteria and sign-off
- Tessa Morgan (enablement) — kickoff agenda, training materials, success checklist

I’ll publish the acceptance checklist to HubSpot and attach the first draft to the kickoff invite.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Principal Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
